observedSurfaces.summary: Cursor Agents exposes New Agent, repository groups, per-repository New Agent entries, thread rows with pin/archive/discard affordances, a draft row, account/settings/status controls, and repository grouping.

The right pane is a separate tabbed preview area with a file tab visible, not a log dump inside the chat stream.
